question: Which measurable topology-composition changes remain bounded when two physically different observations preserve the same masked sibling role, and do those same edit constraints transfer unchanged to Bavaria and LOC?

rolePairFreeze.positiveDefinition: cross-source pair from different frozen physical families that is a reciprocal nearest neighbor in both frozen geometry-only and neighbor-topology-augmented sibling-role spaces
rolePairFreeze.negativeDefinition: same frozen family pair and lane, cross-source, not positive, with both role distances at or above that family-pair lane median
rolePairFreeze.sourceBalance: one deterministic representative per source per frozen physical family before role pairing

trainDiscovery.balancedEffect: mean across physical-family pairs of signed rank-biserial AUC; positive means the edit magnitude is smaller in role-preserving pairs than in matched role-broken pairs
trainDiscovery.null: shuffle preserved/broken labels within each physical-family pair while preserving the observed positive count
trainDiscovery.selection: largest absolute Cleveland/train balanced effect; ties by edit id; holdout and control unavailable to selection

transfer.report: same balanced effect for frozen edit atoms in holdout and control, with sign agreement and retained-effect fraction relative to train
transfer.strongTransferDescriptiveGate: same effect sign in both holdout and control and each absolute transfer effect is at least 25% of the absolute train effect

interpretationLimits.meaning: This test can identify bounded changes in observable topology composition. It cannot yet align individual graph vertices and therefore cannot prove a literal local stroke edit.
